decisions.reason: The schlager compilation CD sits close to the firm's established reissue business and its announced expansion into broader genres, it was presented on its own page, and as a physical release it stays in the warehouse catalog at little ongoing cost, so management is unlikely to withdraw it.

The illustrated release series is a multi-model product line with substantial invested design and production effort and a visible public commitment that fits the curated-edition strategy, so management will persist with it and attribute any weak early sales to the time a series needs to build up.
